name: PRL Wallet — Open source Wallet from Pearl Hub
shortDescription: A local PRL and NOCK wallet with recovery, receive/send, contacts, public prices and encrypted keys.
detailedDescription:
Manage PRL in a browser side panel or full page. Create a 12-word wallet or restore a native Pearl Hub wallet from 12/24 English recovery words. Manage up to 10 wallets on mainnet/testnet, receive with QR and rotating addresses, inspect balances and transaction counterparties, and choose saved contacts when sending.

The same recovery phrase also opens a NOCK (Nockchain) wallet, derived on this device as the official Nockchain wallet does. Receive with a QR code, see the NOCK balance, history and fiat value, and send NOCK after reviewing a receipt and re-entering your password. NOCK is mainnet only.

Mainnet balances can show USD plus one of 17 secondary currencies. Public market requests never contain your wallet address. Open the web miner monitor or watch-only wallet with your address prefilled; saving remains your choice. Optional developer donations use a fixed mainnet address, a preview and password confirmation.

Recovery phrases and pending signed transactions are encrypted locally with AES-256-GCM. Transactions are signed on this device after you review the recipient, amount, fee and total and re-enter your password. An uncertain broadcast keeps the original transaction and reserves its inputs for checking/retry. The wallet locks after 5 idle minutes and when the browser restarts.

No ads, analytics, content scripts, remote executable code or website signing provider. PRL chain queries (public account keys and addresses) and explicitly confirmed signed transactions go to Pearl Hub's own index at pearlhub.net/node, with Pearl's official Blockbook as the fallback. NOCK uses NockBox's public node rpc.nockbox.org; if it can't be reached, the NOCK page lets you allow a backup node (216.158.95.10, plain HTTP) through an optional site permission. NOCK history is read from the nockscan.com block explorer, which receives the NOCK address. The NOCK price comes from CoinGecko without any address. Contacts are stored locally and may optionally sync encrypted. The interface supports all 16 native-app languages.

Only contacts are synced. Recovery phrases, private keys and wallet passwords stay on this device. Inputs with verified address paths can be signed. Change discovery reads outgoing transactions only, with pagination and incremental updates.

Verified paths support any non-hardened child index. Manual pathless discovery covers the first 10,000 internal addresses. Sixteen interface languages; 17 secondary currencies. PRL: Taproot addresses only. No independent security audit. Screenshots use simulated public fixtures.

Optional email account login syncs public contacts with Web and native apps. It uses a separate account session; locking or deleting a wallet does not sign out the account. Wallet secrets stay local.

permissionJustifications.storage: Locally stores encrypted wallets, encrypted pending transactions, public contacts and preferences; the trusted session holds the unlock key until lock. No Chrome account sync.
permissionJustifications.alarms: Checks inactivity once per minute to enforce the 5-minute automatic lock.
permissionJustifications.sidePanel: Opens the packaged wallet UI in the browser side panel when its toolbar icon is clicked.
permissionJustifications.https://blockbook.pearlresearch.ai/*: Fallback for mainnet balances, public account/address history, UTXOs, fees and transaction status when Pearl Hub's own index is unavailable or behind; transaction lookups and explicitly confirmed locally signed broadcasts go to both.
Same chain queries and explicitly confirmed broadcasts, restricted to testnet.
permissionJustifications.https://pearlhub.net/*: Pearl Hub's own blockchain index at pearlhub.net/node is asked first for balances, address history, UTXOs, fees and transaction status (sending the wallet's public account key and addresses) and receives explicitly confirmed signed transactions. Public market requests carry no wallet identity. Optional email account login and authenticated configuration sync share contact names, public addresses and notes. Account data is encrypted at rest and readable by the server; wallet seed phrases, private keys and passwords are never uploaded.
permissionJustifications.identity: Opens the Pearl Hub email sign-in page and receives a one-use PKCE authorization callback. Does not read your Google or Microsoft account.
permissionJustifications.http://216.158.95.10/*: Optional; requested only when the user taps Allow on the NOCK page after NockBox's node (rpc.nockbox.org) could not be reached. A second Nockchain node, the default of the official Nockchain wallet (plain HTTP), for the NOCK balance, transaction lookups and explicitly confirmed NOCK broadcasts. Not used unless granted.

dataUseDisclosure: Financial data: public wallet/account addresses, balances, transaction history and confirmed signed transactions are processed for wallet operation; Pearl Hub's own Blockbook index (pearlhub.net/node) receives chain queries, with the official Blockbook as the fallback; signed broadcasts go to both. Secret recovery phrases, private keys and passwords stay on-device. Public contact names/addresses/notes and preferences stay local. Market services receive public GET requests without wallet identity; infrastructure can observe IP addresses. Web links pass a public address in the URL fragment only after a user click; the web app may then query it. No analytics, advertising, sale of data, browsing-history collection or Chrome account sync. Do not select “no data used”: financial data is processed even when it stays local or goes only to blockchain indexers. NOCK: once the user opens NOCK, identifiers derived from the NOCK address go to NockBox's public node rpc.nockbox.org (and, only if the user allows it, to the backup node 216.158.95.10 over plain HTTP) for the balance and history lookups, and confirmed signed NOCK transactions are broadcast there; the NOCK address goes to the nockscan.com block explorer for the transaction history; the NOCK price comes from CoinGecko without wallet identity. The NOCK address and history stay unencrypted in local storage and are removed with the wallet. Optional email accounts store email, public contacts and device/session metadata on Cloudflare. Configuration is encrypted at rest; the server can read it. Sign out restores the previous guest contacts. Cloud configuration export and account deletion are available on the account page.
